title: AI Model Testing & Scenario-Based Evaluation Harness (Safe Pre-Production)
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (synthetic clinical data / AI test enablement; data-engineering/simulation/governance work, privacy care).

Synthetic-data & digital-twin tools (e.g. Synthea, commercial platforms) and AI/model frameworks integrated at the pattern level; vendor internals cited or deferred, never invented. Regulatory/legal interpretation (HIPAA/HITRUST de-identification, IRB/privacy sign-off, disclosure risk) deferred to privacy/compliance/legal. Never real PHI in a shared harness/twin/AI test env. Automation is Python.
hook: Evaluate AI models against scenarios before you ship them
problem: AI teams need to prove a model is safe and useful before production — against realistic, repeatable scenarios, not one-off demos. This solution builds an AI model testing and scenario-based evaluation harness: define evaluation scenarios and metrics, run models against synthetic/twin data, capture results with pass/fail gates, and make the whole thing reusable — so AI is evaluated safely and consistently before broader adoption.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the evaluation model: scenarios, metrics, test data (synthetic/twin), pass/fail gates, and reusability.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (synthetic/twin data, model access, evaluation metrics, isolated environment, use cases).

Implementation Guide — define evaluation scenarios + metrics, wire the model and synthetic/twin data, run evaluations with pass/fail gates, capture results, and make the harness reusable, pilot-first.

5 Python tools — assessment/profiling, generation or scenario execution, a fidelity/coverage report, a privacy/validation check, and a scope/config helper — authentic to synthetic-data engineering (safe by default; no real PHI written to shared locations).
Testing/validation gates (scenarios run, metrics captured, gates enforced) plus Best Practices for repeatable, comparable evaluation.
short: Build an AI model testing and scenario-based evaluation harness — scenarios, metrics, synthetic/twin test data, and pass/fail gates — so AI is evaluated safely and consistently before production. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
